d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_Mutual.label: Silverline Mutual
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_Mutual.descri: The calm, neutral default. Quietly holds your silver, charges fair fees and has never once been in the news. The clerks are suspiciously well rested.
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_Mutual.slogan: Quietly holding things since the Third Collapse.
First Rim Bank of Too Big To Fail

Satire in a marble lobby. Higher yields, higher fees, and once per game year it will rescue a customer who has been truly, spectacularly rich and is now not. The rescue is a loan, not a gift. Nobody reads that part.
So big we had to name it twice.
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_ImperialTreas: The Throne's own counting house. Low fees, a faint smell of floor polish and credit only for those who bear a title. Withdrawals are called "disbursements" and come with a small bow.
Every coin bears the Throne's profile. Please do not bite it.
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_OrbitalExchan: A trading-guild bank on a very expensive rotating ring. Best market access in the rim, highest fees in the rim, and every receipt arrives with a small chart that goes up and to the right.
Liquidity at the speed of light. Fees too.
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_BlackLedger.d: No questions, no forms, no names. Lends to anyone, whatever their score, at a price. Once in a while a ledger "goes missing" and a share of the deposits with it.
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_BlackLedger.s: We don't ask. You don't tell. The interest still compounds.
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_CompoundInter: A congregation that worships the miracle of exponential growth. Modest fees, a hymn for every balance sheet and a donation box that is, strictly speaking, optional.
In compound we trust. Tithe early, tithe often.
d:ThingDef/SL_ATM.label: ATM
d:ThingDef/SL_ATM.description: A steel box with a screen, a keypad and a slot that says "silver" in four languages. Colonists use it to look at their account, withdraw silver (daily limit, small fee) and deposit what they have. Needs power.
d:ThingDef/SL_BankCounter.label: bank counter
d:ThingDef/SL_BankCounter.description: A long wooden counter with brass fittings and a little bell nobody is allowed to ring. A branch of your bank: deposits are booked at once, cash comes straight from the vault and loans are signed in person. Needs power.
d:ThingDef/SL_NightSafe.label: night safe
d:ThingDef/SL_NightSafe.description: A hatch in a steel block. Put the day's takings in, hear it clunk, go home. Every midnight the tills of your businesses are emptied here: into your bank account if you have one, as silver on the floor next to it if you do not.
d:FactionDef/SL_CollectionsAgency.label: Rim Recovery Partners
d:FactionDef/SL_CollectionsAgency.descri: A collection agency. Polite until it is not.
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.0.label: drowning in debt
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.0.descri: We owe more than the colony is worth. The post smells of overdue letters.
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.1.label: broke
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.1.descri: The account is empty. Even the ATM looks at us with pity.
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.2.label: scraping by
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.2.descri: We have a little in the bank. Very little. Nobody says it out loud.
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.3.label: getting by
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.4.label: comfortable
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.4.descri: Comfortable, and not worried about it.
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.5.label: savings
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.5.descri: We have savings. It is a strange, warm feeling.
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.6.label: rich
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.6.descri: We are rich. Not that anyone mentions it at dinner.
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.7.label: filthy rich
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.7.descri: The colony is filthy rich. We have started buying things we do not need.
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.8.label: too big to fail
d:ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.8.descri: We are too big to fail. Somebody has to say it and it might as well be us.
Debt. Debt! I can feel every silver coin we do not have.
Broke. I did not become greedy to be broke.
Hardly anything in the account. I check it every hour.
Fine. But it could be more.
Comfortable. But it could be more.
Savings, in a vault, with my name near it. Lovely.
Rich! I will not stop counting.
Filthy rich. This is what I was born for.
Too big to fail. Frame the balance sheet.
Two men in bowler hats are standing near the door. They are very polite about it.
d:ResearchProjectDef/SL_Banking.label: automated tellers
d:ResearchProjectDef/SL_Banking.descript: Machines that hand out silver to anyone who types the right four digits. Unlocks the ATM and the night safe.
d:ResearchProjectDef/SL_Branches.label: bank branches
d:ResearchProjectDef/SL_Branches.descrip: A proper counter, a proper vault and a proper queue. Unlocks the bank counter: instant deposits, instant cash, loan applications in person.
d:ResearchProjectDef/SL_Credit.label: consumer credit
d:ResearchProjectDef/SL_Credit.descripti: Money you do not have, for people who do not have it. Unlocks loans, the credit score and, if it comes to that, the collection agency.
